articles.summary: Kratos has successfully demonstrated end-to-end connectivity across a native, multi-vendor 5G NR NTN using Kratos’ OpenSpace®, the industry’s first fully virtualized and software-defined satellite ground system platform.
articles.title: Kratos Advances 5G NR NTN Ground System Development with Multi-Vendor Connectivity Success

articles.title: Kratos Breaks Ground on New AN/SPY-1 Radar and Helios Hypersonics Testing Facilities in Indiana
